review_summary: Plan is well-grounded and closely verified against the actual codebase (schema fields, existing chip/card rendering, action pattern all check out); only minor scope-creep and a documentation nit were found.

issues.title: Showcase meta fields go beyond the clarified scope
issues.description: Clarification specifies the showcase should include "bio, style/specialty tags, and social handle plus gallery." Task 3 additionally adds an experience/rating/pieces meta row (mirroring the public web artist page) which was not part of the clarified requirement set. This is low-risk (data already exists, no new schema/query cost) but is technically feature creep beyond what was agreed.
issues.suggested_fix: Either confirm with the user that experience/rating/pieces should be included, or trim the hero meta row to just bio + style/specialty tags + insta handle + gallery per the clarification, keeping the extra fields as a fast-follow if desired.

issues.title: Gotcha note misattributes GalleryItem.headshot
issues.description: The plan's Gotchas section states "GalleryItem.image/headshot are admin-uploaded URLs (nullable)" but `headshot` is a field on `Artist` (schema.prisma:197), not `GalleryItem` (schema.prisma:424-439, which has no `headshot` field). Task 1's actual select logic correctly pulls `headshot` from the Artist query, so this doesn't affect implementation, but the note could confuse a reader skimming just the Gotchas list.
issues.suggested_fix: Reword to "Artist.headshot and GalleryItem.image are both nullable admin-uploaded URLs" to avoid implying headshot lives on GalleryItem.
